newsitem.title: USA: Valley Forge Sci introduces global products.
newsitem.headline: Valley Forge Sci introduces global products.

text.p: Valley Forge Scientific Corp said Monday that its bipolar electrosurgical system and a coagulator designed specifically for worldwide surgical markets, was introduced at the recent annual meeting of the American Association of Neurological Surgeons.
The company said that each of the products has met strict international requirements for design and quality, and has been approved for sale in developed countries outside North America.

Vally Froge said that an international model of its Malis CMC III bipolar electrosurgical system has received approval for marketing in Eastern and Western Europe, Australia, China and the Pacific Rim and has earned the CE Mark.
The international version of the Malis Synergy Coagulator has also been designed for worldwide sale, the company said.
